dbt information schema

Type: object

The schema of every table in the dbt information schema, in one file. Each property is the schema of one row of that table. dbt tables hold project metadata, dbt_rt tables hold runtime results.

root dbt.project

dbt.project

Type: object

Primary key: project_name.

root dbt.project schema_version
Type: integer or null

root dbt.project project_name
Type: string or null

Part of the primary key.

root dbt.project dbt_version
Type: string or null

Type: string or null

Type: string or null

root dbt.project git_branch
Type: string or null

root dbt.project git_uncommitted_changes
Type: boolean or null

root dbt.project last_full_parse_at
Type: string or nullFormat: date-time

root dbt.project ingested_at
Type: string or nullFormat: date-time
